calibration: Six calendar months immediately before each test year; never train trees on calibration or test targets
metrics: MAE, RMS log error and nominal 90% interval coverage at 6/12/24 h, per fold and pooled; threshold contingency on once-per-day origins at 1.1e8 and 4.8e8
statisticalSupport: 2000 paired block bootstrap resamples, stratified by test fold, with 7-calendar-day blocks and 27-day sensitivity. Whole blocks retain every eligible origin. Confidence intervals are conditional on this archive and fixed design, not post-selection-adjusted guarantees.
selection: No hyperparameter tuning, retrospective artifact replacement or automatic promotion based on these results; publish every variant and fold
limits: Historical receipt times and some provider revisions are unavailable
GOES-16/19 handoff changes measurement location; report by spacecraft and expose unseen-spacecraft folds
The recipe was developed after inspecting other historical dates, so this is chronological out-of-sample hindcasting, not a pristine blind operational trial
Reconstructed HUXt future speed and new CH geometry are not included without paired historical inputs
